Name: Disguise
Effect: The first time this Pokémon would receive damage due to a Physical or Special Move, reduce that damage to zero. Entry Hazards, Weather Conditions and Status Ailments do not trigger this Ability. Unique Ability.
Description: This Pokémon wears a convincing disguise of another Pokémon. If it receives damage, the disguise breaks, making it appear as if it received a fatal injury.
